brief: Comfort socks and tees where every purchase donates an item to someone experiencing homelessness. Average order $65. Great for gifting and for families buying multi-packs.

profile.business_summary: A DTC apparel brand selling comfort socks and tees with a 1-for-1 donation model supporting individuals experiencing homelessness. The brand has an average order value of $65 and targets families and gift-buyers.
stated_claims: Every purchase donates an item to someone experiencing homelessness
